core_question: Does current-state information provide value specifically for Utility/state selection under a frozen dimension-valid PDE-structured parent?

utility_predictability.scope: Current-state information improves per-term Utility predictability across unseen-Pr and unseen-Ra.

closed_loop_prediction.scope: StateUtility yields small but consistent closed-loop predictive gains over matched ParamUtility on both unseen parameter axes.

final_candidate_vs_r3_2a.scope: StateUtility has lower global rollout AUC than the strongest matched R3-2a ParamOnly control on both unseen-Pr and unseen-Ra.

physical_consistency.scope: State-selective Utility does not consistently improve the predeclared FD-based physics proxies.
physical_consistency.interpretation: Localized pathway-specific improvements occur, particularly for buoyancy-related proxies under unseen-Ra, but global physical-consistency improvements are not supported.

mechanistic_interpretation.supported: Current-state information is useful for deciding whether/when a dimension-valid physical pathway should be trusted for predictive utility.
mechanistic_interpretation.not_supported: Current-state information does not demonstrate consistent improvement of overall physical consistency under the present prediction-error-defined Utility target.
mechanistic_interpretation.key_distinction: predictive Utility is not equivalent to physical Utility

limitations: closed-loop predictive effect size is small
Utility supervision is defined from prediction error rather than physics consistency
physics metrics are FD-based comparative proxies rather than solver-level PDE residual truth
overall_closeout: R3-3 CLOSED — STATE-SELECTIVE PREDICTIVE UTILITY SUPPORTED; PHYSICAL-CONSISTENCY BENEFIT NOT CONSISTENTLY SUPPORTED
next_stage_implication: R4 should preserve the dimension-valid and state-selective predictive mechanism while explicitly addressing the gap between predictive Utility and physical Utility; physics results must not be retrospectively used to redesign or reinterpret the frozen R3-3 prediction experiment.
